attempts.summary: Blacklisted the usb-storage kernel module on node1 both immediately and persistently across reboot: added /etc/modprobe.d/blacklist-usb-storage.conf (blacklist + install /bin/false), rebuilt the initramfs with dracut --force so the rule applies at early boot, verified modprobe now refuses to load the module, then performed the mandatory single-node restart evidence protocol (baseline boot_id/health capture, systemctl reboot, polled until exec access returned, confirmed boot_id changed, and reverified post-reboot that usb-storage remains blocked and unloaded with the system fully running).
